name: Auckland University of Technology (AUT)
educationLevels: Bachelors, English Course, Graduate Diploma, Masters, PhD
description: Auckland University of Technology (AUT) is the second largest university in New Zealand, with 100,000 alumni around the world. It is located in Auckland, voted the third best city in the world to live in. In the 2018 QS World University Rankings, AUT was ranked in the 441–450 band, which puts it in the top 2% of universities worldwide, and the 2017 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Ranking ranked AUT as one of the top 20 universities worldwide for International Outlook. AUT is also amongst the world's top 60 young universities and ranked for the first time in THE's top 150 universities under 50 years old. The AUT Business School has been recognized as one of the top business schools in the world by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) International.
